title: Scheme Source Metadata
description: Metadata schema for each scraped mutual fund scheme document.

source_url.description: The exact URL from which the data was scraped.

scheme_name.description: The full name of the mutual fund scheme.

category.description: Category of the fund (e.g., Small Cap, ELSS).

document_type.description: Type of the document, typically 'HTML' for Groww pages.

scrape_date.description: ISO 8601 formatted date and time when the document was scraped.

elss_lock_in.description: Lock-in period for ELSS funds. Null for non-ELSS funds (Edge Case 1.A.4 mitigation).
